data.credibility: Management guides transparently on operational metrics like tax rates and delivers successfully within ranges. However, they occasionally drop or stop mentioning long-term top-line aspirations such as the $2B FY27 target without clear explanation, indicating mixed consistency on multi-year strategic goals.

lines.line: Aspiration to reach $2 billion by FY27 was dropped after being unmentioned.
Aspiration of $5 billion in annual revenue by FY31 remains on track.
Effective tax rate of 22.6% delivered within the 20% to 24% range.

bull: Revenue compounded at 28.6% and net profit at 32.8% annually over five years, reaching USD 1,654.34 Million.
Operating cash flow reached 101% of reported profit over five years, showing strong cash conversion.
EBITDA margin widened from 16.3% in FY21 to 19.0% in FY26, backed by a high ROCE of 34.4%.
bear: Growth is slowing, with three-year revenue growth dropping to 20.9% compared to 28.6% over five years.
Working-capital days stretched significantly from 25 to 50 days over the last five years.
Borrowings rose from ₹98 cr in FY21 to ₹575 cr in FY26, increasing financial leverage.
